answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 30705 Country: India Title: I want to know that, if a muslim boy married to a non muslim or a muslim girl married to a non muslim boy is non islamik as per islamic belief. Question: SIR , I WANT TO KNOW THAT, IF A MUSLIM BOY MARRIED TO A NON MUSLIM OR A MUSLIM GIRL MARRIED TO A NON MUSLIM BOY IS NON ISLAMIK AS PER ISLAMIC BELIEF. Answer ID: 30705 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 411/411/M=1432) The nikah of Muslim boy with non-Muslim girl and vice versa is unlawful and haram. وَلاَ تَنكِحُواْ الْمُشْرِكَاتِ حَتَّى يُؤْمِنَّ الآية . (القرآن) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
